title: The Pact's Ink Runs
text: In the Commons archive, the Sovereign Pact itself has begun to weep. The ink of the founding signatures runs down the vellum in thin black lines. If the names wash away, the clerks say, so does the oath that has held the city together. The Houses must decide what to do with it.

options.label: Every House signs the Pact again in blood, binding the city anew.

outcomes.text: Each House sends a Scion to the archive to sign with a cut thumb, and the ink stops running. The new signatures are a little too red, and they never quite dry.

options.label: Have the clerks make a fair copy, trusting ink to hold what ink once held.

outcomes.text: The clerks copy it word for word, and the copy mostly holds. Every few nights a clerk finds a word in it that was not in the original.

options.label: Let the old names fade; the Houses are their own now.

outcomes.text: The founding names wash away. The Houses feel lighter and freer, and much less inclined to keep their word.
